title: Hugh Fleming
description: "l beg of you, George, don't succumb to inevitable studio demands that Steven Seagal play young Obi-Wan in the next trilogy..." frets Australian illustrator Hugh Fleming. "My vote is with actor/director Kenneth Branagh, the only performer with the dignity and presence to fill Sir Alec Guinness' Jedi robes." A hopeless STAR WARS junkie from age 10, Fleming has painted numerous INDIANA JONES covers for Dark Horse and the recent UNIVERSAL MONSTERS ILLUSTRATED display box/poster for the Topps card set. He simply hates having his picture taken.
